other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage in feature engineering
other_failure_modes.description: Calculating aggregated features, such as frequency encodings or groupby statistics, on the combined train and test dataset before splitting leaks test set distributions into the training features.

summary: The agent implements a generally solid pipeline with LightGBM, including proper out-of-fold target encoding and handling of skewed targets via log transformation. However, it introduces critical data leakage by calculating frequency encodings and groupby aggregations on the combined train and test datasets. Additionally, it ignores the temporal nature of the funding data by using a randomized K-Fold split.
